name: ZENIT 3D HT 300 0.4 nozzle
machine_end_gcode:
G1 E-1.0 F2100 ; retract
G92 E0.0
G1{if max_layer_z < max_print_height} Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+30, max_print_height)}{endif}
G4 ; wait
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X230 Y215 F3000 ; park print head
M84 ; disable motors
machine_start_gcode:
G29 S1
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode
M204 S[machine_max_acceleration_extruding] T[machine_max_acceleration_retracting]
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; set extruder temp
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for extruder temp
G28 ; home all
G1 X115.0  Y200.0 Z0.3 F1000 ; move print head up
G92 E0.0
